topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can't believe it. All this time, I thought I knew you, trusted you. You said you had this amazing job, that you were doing so well. But now I find out it was all a lie? I keep going over our conversations, trying to remember if there were signs, hints I missed. I feel like I don't know anything anymore. What were you thinking? Why would you do this? I need to understand, to hear it from you, but I'm scared to ask. Our friendship feels so fragile right now, hanging by a thread.
